senses.definition: A feeling of extreme happiness or cheerfulness, especially related to the acquisition or expectation of something good.
examples: a child's joy on Christmas morning
It is his joy to walk in the rain.

quotes.text: […]purſued his vnneighbourly purpoſe in ſuch ſort: that hee being the ſtronger perſwader, and ſhe (belike) too credulous in beleeuing or elſe ouer-feeble in reſiſting, from priuate imparlance, they fell to action; and continued their cloſe fight a long while together, vnſeene and vvithout ſuſpition, no doubt to their equall ioy and contentment.
